title: ecompass
source_docs: Sensor Fusion and Tracking Toolbox/Multisensor Positioning/Navigation Filters/ecompass.md
text: Compute orientation from accelerometer and magnetometer readings, 2 inputs, 1 output; {Reference frame} sets the navigation reference frame, {Orientation format} sets the format used to describe orientation and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Accel
ports.summary: Accelerometer readings N -by-3 matrix of real scalar

ports.name: Mag
ports.summary: Magnetometer readings N -by-3 matrix of real scalar

ports.name: Orientation
ports.summary: Orientation that rotates quantities from global coordinate system to sensor body coordinate system N -by-4 matrix of quaternions (default) | 3-by-3-by- N array

params.name: Orientation format
params.values: Format used to describe orientation quaternion (default) | Rotation matrix

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
